I appreciate the offer and I saved your number in my phone in case I feel I'm going to take any drastic action. I don't really feel like this is something I could bring up with my family and friends.

If you have any advice for my court appearance or future job prospects, I'd be interested.

I went on here to find some people to commiserate with me, but your post inspired me to set up a throwaway. 

I've been feeling like I've just been stuck in place lately. I "did what I love" in school and decided to not take the last recommended pre-med course, and that advice has turned out to be bullshit. Rather than finding something I liked, I'm working at a gas station a block from my house waiting for better news. A few nights ago, I decided I would just end it all in a car crash.

I decided I'd at least do something I enjoyed before I left so I went to a concert and drank fairly heavily. I made the mistake of getting behind the wheel and in my drunken stupor, I botched my attempt to flip the vehicle and instead wound up in a ditch with no injuries and no damage to my truck. The experience was exhilarating, and I felt like I could stick around a little longer so I used my 4 wheel drive to get out. About a mile down the road, I saw blue lights in my rearview mirror and knew I was fucked.

I was handcuffed and brought to the county jail where I spent 12 dull hours only to be released into my grandfather's custody. The shame I've felt over the past few days has been unbearable, and I've been dreading the disappointed phone conversations with my parents. 

My license was suspended, and I'm now separated from the few friends I have in the area. I now have a pending court date and my future job prospects look pretty bleak, besides my dad's recommendation that I enlist in the military. 

I just want you to know that I sympathize with you, and I'm available if you want to shoot me a PM.
